verdict.rationale: Unleash documents self-hosting the core server in your own environment. Its Docker guide covers both Open Source and Enterprise, starting with cloning the repo and running Docker Compose. Community users independently describe it as an open-source, self-hosted alternative they evaluated, and Edge can also run self-hosted in front of the instance. Missing for 10: in-depth production self-hosting docs in the pack (scaling, upgrades, database configuration beyond the quickstart).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
